header_bilingual.program: Desarrollo de Medios Gráficos Visuales — Programa 522309
header_bilingual.guide: Guía 1 — The Visual Communicator / El Comunicador Visual
header_bilingual.rap: 240202501-01 — Reconocer elementos del lenguaje visual en contextos comunicativos bilingües
header_bilingual.instruction_es: Responde las 25 preguntas marcando UNA sola opción (A, B, C o D). No se permite consulta de materiales. Cada respuesta correcta = 1 punto. Lee con calma.
header_bilingual.instruction_en: Answer all 25 questions by marking ONE option (A, B, C, or D). No material consultation allowed. Each correct answer = 1 point. Read carefully.

section_1_reading.instruction_es: Lee el siguiente extracto del Master Anchor Text (Sesión 2) y responde las 5 preguntas.
section_1_reading.instruction_en: Read the following extract from the Master Anchor Text (Session 2) and answer the 5 questions.
section_1_reading.anchor_text_reprint_en: Andrés is a junior designer at Pixel & Ink Studio. Today is Monday. He reads an email from Sophia, a client from Boston. She wants a new logo and a poster. She writes: 'Use a serif font in bold. Warm colors only. No cool colors. Friday is the deadline.' Andrés opens his laptop and opens Canva. He clicks on the toolbar. He does not know the word 'serif'. He opens Creative Bloq, a design website. The article explains: a serif font has small lines at the ends of letters. Times New Roman is a serif font. Arial is a sans-serif font. Serif fonts are good for traditional brands. Warm colors like red and orange are traditional. Cool colors like blue are modern.

items.stem_en: Where does Andrés work?
When is Sophia's deadline?
What does Andrés do when he does NOT know the word 'serif'?
Why does Sophia ask for warm colors?

options.C: Warm colors are traditional and her client is traditional
options.D: Warm colors are easy to print

items.stem_en: Which font is Times New Roman?

section_2_writing.instruction_es: Andrés está escribiendo un email a Sophia sobre su decisión de diseño. Responde las 5 preguntas sobre la forma correcta del email.
section_2_writing.instruction_en: Andrés is writing an email to Sophia about his design decision. Answer the 5 questions about the correct form of the email.

items.stem_en: Which greeting is correct for a semi-formal design email to Sophia?
Complete: 'The logo is ____ round seal.'
Which sentence is correct?

options.C: The the warm colors are traditional.

items.stem_en: Which sentence states a DECISION (not a rationale)?
Which closing fits a semi-formal design email?

section_3_listening.instruction_es: El instructor reproducirá el audio de Laura explicando la color wheel a Andrés (audio de Sesión 4, 2:30 min). Lo escucharás DOS veces. Luego responde las 5 preguntas.
section_3_listening.instruction_en: The instructor will play the audio of Laura explaining the color wheel to Andrés (Session 4 audio, 2:30 min). You will listen TWICE. Then answer the 5 questions.
section_3_listening.audio_reference: pm-2-6.auditory_anchor_script — Laura tutorial color wheel + Sophia bakery brief

items.stem_en: How many colors are on the color wheel (according to Laura)?
Who teaches the color-wheel refresher in the audio?
Why does Sophia want warm colors for the bakery?
A bank client wants a logo. Which palette fits (based on Laura's rule)?
Laura says: 'Open the canvas in Illustrator.' Here, 'canvas' means:

options.B: The digital workspace in design software

section_4_vocabulary.instruction_es: Responde las 5 preguntas sobre los 20 términos del Toolbelt (Sesiones 2–5).
section_4_vocabulary.instruction_en: Answer the 5 questions about the 20 Toolbelt terms (Sessions 2–5).

items.stem_en: Which font has small lines at the ends of letters?
Red, orange, and yellow are ____ colors.
Equal weight on both sides of a design is called:
A transparent level on top of the canvas is called:
A small symbol that represents a brand is called:

section_5_grammar.instruction_es: Responde las 5 preguntas de gramática. Selecciona la opción correcta.
section_5_grammar.instruction_en: Answer the 5 grammar questions. Select the correct option.

items.stem_en: Complete: 'The colors ____ warm.'
Complete: '____ is the brief for the bakery client.'
Complete: 'Andrés opens ____ email from Sophia.'
Rewrite as an instruction: 'You save the file in Canva.'

options.A: You are saving the file in Canva.

items.stem_en: Complete: 'The font is serif ____ the color is warm.' (both decisions agree with traditional brand)

scoring_matrix_instructor.instruction: Marque cada respuesta como correcta (1 pt) o incorrecta (0 pt). Sume por sección y total.

interpretation_scale.23_25_excelente: Dominio A1.1 sólido. Listo para A1.2.
interpretation_scale.18_22_logrado: Dominio A1.1 funcional. Áreas específicas a reforzar en Misión Final.

interpretation_scale.0_12_no_logrado: Dominio insuficiente. Plan de recuperación: revisar Workbook S2–S5 + tutorías antes de re-evaluar.
